keyword: who has won back to back masters

verifications.claim: Only three golfers in history have won back-to-back Masters tournaments.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4: lists only Jack Nicklaus (1965-66), Nick Faldo (1989-90), Tiger Woods (2001-02), no one since; R3/R5: lists four including Rory McIlroy (2025-26)
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: some state only three have won back-to-back, others explicitly include McIlroy as the fourth.

verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1965–1966.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Jack Nicklaus: 1965-66' (all sources); 'Jack Nicklaus became the first back-to-back champion at the Masters in 1965-66'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm Nicklaus won consecutive Masters in 1965-1966.

verifications.claim: Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1989–1990.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Nick Faldo: 1989-90' (all sources); 'Nick Faldo became only the second Masters champion to win back-to-back titles...1989-90'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm Faldo won consecutive Masters in 1989-1990.

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2001–2002.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Tiger Woods: 2001-02' (all sources); 'Tiger Woods won the Masters in 2001...The following year...2002'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm Woods won consecutive Masters in 2001-2002.

verifications.claim: No golfer has won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'To date, no one has ever won three Masters titles in a row' (R1/R2); 'No, no golfer has ever won three Masters Tournaments in a row' (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references explicitly state no golfer has won three consecutive Masters.

verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus was the first to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'Jack Nicklaus became the first back-to-back champion at the Masters in 1965-66' (R1/R2); 'Nicklaus was the first golfer to ever win consecutive Masters tournaments' (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm Nicklaus was the first to achieve back-to-back wins.

verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus won the 1965 Masters by nine strokes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'In 1965, Nicklaus beat Palmer by nine strokes, a record that stood until 1997' (R1/R2)
verifications.reasoning: References directly state Nicklaus won 1965 Masters by nine strokes over Palmer.

verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus won the 1966 Masters in an 18-hole playoff.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'the following year, he won an 18-hole playoff against Tommy Jacobs and Gay Brewer' (R1/R2)
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm 1966 win via 18-hole playoff.

verifications.claim: Nick Faldo won the 1989 Masters in a playoff defeating Scott Hoch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'in 1989, when Scott Hoch missed a two-foot par putt...Faldo...holing a 25-footer for birdie on the second extra hole' (R1/R2); 'Faldo and Scott Hoch...playoff...Faldo drained a long birdie putt' (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm Faldo defeated Hoch in 1989 playoff.

verifications.claim: Nick Faldo won the 1990 Masters in a playoff defeating Raymond Floyd.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'the following year, Faldo...defeating Raymond Floyd in a playoff' (R1/R2); 'He and Raymond Floyd both finished 10-under...Faldo...parred the par-4 11th hole while Floyd didn't' (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm Faldo defeated Floyd in 1990 playoff.

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods is the most recent player to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4: 'Over two decades later, no champion has managed to successfully defend since [Woods]'; R3/R5: McIlroy won 2025-26 back-to-back
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: some state no one since Woods (most recent), others state McIlroy won more recently.

verifications.claim: Tiger Woods secured his second and third green jackets in 2001–2002.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 'When Tiger Woods won the Masters in 1997...In winning the Masters in 2001...The following year [2002]' (R1/R2); 'Woods' second and third green jackets came in 2001 and 2002' (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References confirm Woods' first win 1997, thus 2001-2002 were his second and third.
